title: Mark Andrew Kozlowski Launches New Personal Website to Share Insights on Marine Innovation and Sustainability | User | ridgwayrecord.com
text:
Mark Andrew Kozlowski, Nova Scotia-Based Entrepreneur Unveils Digital Hub for Ocean Conservation, Technology, and Thought Leadership Mark Andrew Kozlowski, a leading voice in marine technology and sustainability, has officially launched his new personal website, https://www.markandrewkozlowskinovascotia.com/ . The site serves as a central hub for his work, offering insights into ocean conservation, renewable energy solutions, and the intersection of technology and sustainability.
With a background in offshore engineering and environmental sciences, Kozlowski has built a career dedicated to developing innovative solutions that protect marine ecosystems while advancing industry practices. As the founder and CEO of Blue Horizon Technologies, he has spearheaded projects in AI-driven fisheries management, offshore wind energy optimization, and sustainable maritime operations.
“This website is more than just a platform—it’s a way to connect with people who care about the future of our oceans,” says Kozlowski. “I want to share knowledge, spark conversations, and inspire real-world solutions for marine conservation and sustainable business.”
Visitors to the site will find:
In-depth articles and insights on the latest trends in marine technology and conservation
Updates on Blue Horizon Technologies' projects and innovations
Speaking engagements and event appearances featuring Kozlowski
A resource hub for businesses, researchers, and policymakers looking to adopt sustainable marine practices
Kozlowski hopes the website will become a go-to resource for industry professionals, environmental advocates, and young innovators looking to make a difference. His goal is to bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and practical solutions that can be applied across multiple sectors.
“There’s a lot of talk about sustainability, but action comes from education and collaboration,” he explains. “This site is a step toward making real, lasting change by sharing what works—and what doesn’t—when it comes to protecting our oceans.”
With climate change and industrial pressures threatening marine environments worldwide, Kozlowski emphasizes the importance of accessible, science-driven solutions. Through his new platform, he aims to highlight not just the challenges, but also the opportunities that exist in sustainable ocean industries.
The launch of the new website marks a new chapter in his mission to create a more responsible, technology-driven future for marine conservation and industry.
About Mark Andrew Kozlowski
Mark Andrew Kozlowski is a marine technology entrepreneur and sustainability advocate based in Nova Scotia, Canada. As the founder and CEO of Blue Horizon Technologies, he develops sustainable solutions for offshore industries, bridging the gap between environmental responsibility and economic success. Kozlowski is also an educator and public speaker, working to inspire the next generation of ocean innovators.
To read more, visit the website here: https://www.markandrewkozlowskinovascotia.com/
